'''Inter-Galactic "No-Fault" Flight Insurance''' was a type of flight insurance available for [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] travelers. [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] passengers could obtain the insurance at the company counter at the [[Tomorrowland Starport]].
